title: Console list: grouping headers and the filter value picker label a lookup by its raw id when the target is titled by a nameField other than name, and the empty group reads "(empty)" untranslated
body:
Found in a browser regression run of a downstream app (steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm) on the published 18.5.0 packages. The code paths below are unchanged on `origin/main` at `4443014630`.

This is **not** #33107. That card fixed the analytics dimension-label pass (`service-analytics`). This one is the console grid's own label resolution, in a different package.

## What a user sees (zh-CN, sales manager)

Setup: the object `crm_cb_order` has a lookup `deal_confirmation` → `crm_deal_confirmation`. The target declares `nameField: 'deal_number'` (an autonumber, `DEAL-{YYYY}-{0000}`) and has no `name`, `label` or `title` field.

| Surface | Rendered | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Grid cell of `deal_confirmation` in the same list | `DEAL-2026-0001` ✅ | — |
| Group headers of a list view with `grouping: { fields: [{ field: 'deal_confirmation' }] }` | `T1lF9T1kq45KAN06`, `mhHko1m3h9-1aahG`, … (raw ids) | `DEAL-2026-0001`, … |
| Filter builder → field 成交编号 → value picker options | `KC3TKTKQPLwGVqsJ`, `T1lF9T1kq45KAN06`, … (raw ids) | `DEAL-2026-0002`, … |
| Group header for rows with no value | `(empty)` in English under zh-CN | a localized empty label |

Grouping and filter results are correct. Only the labels are wrong.

## Controlled check

I used the same database, the same user and the same view twice:
- **Run 1:** the lookup as shipped, with no `displayField`.
- **Run 2:** the same lookup with `displayField: 'deal_number'` added.

In run 2, both the group headers and the filter picker show `DEAL-…`, and `(empty)` stays English. So the label code honours an explicit field-level `displayField` but never falls back to the target object's declared `nameField`.

The spec documents the opposite default. `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:2239`, for the lookup `displayField`, reads: "defaults to the referenced object's name/title".

## Producers (origin/main)

- **Server-grouped headers.** `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useServerGrouping.ts:227` takes `displayField` from the field definition only. Line ~292 then labels each id `(displayField ? rec[displayField] : undefined) ?? rec.name ?? rec.label ?? rec.title`, and with none of these the raw id is shown.
- **Client grouping.** `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useGroupedData.ts` follows the same `name ?? label ?? title` heuristic: line 124, and `buildSegmentLabel` at ~156–193. `buildSegmentLabel` also returns the literal `'(empty)'` at lines 161, 176 and 193, with no i18n key.
- **Filter value picker.** `ui/packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx:2715` sets `const displayField = field.displayField || "name"`. Line 2742 then falls back to `r?.label ?? r?.name ?? String(id)`.

## Suggested fix shape (for the lane to judge)

- When the lookup field has no `displayField`, resolve the label from the target object's declared `nameField` (the title the grid cell and record header already use), before the `name/label/title` heuristic. This applies to all three producers. A shared helper would keep them from drifting; `ui/packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts` already resolves record titles.
- Localize the empty-group label, using the console's existing empty-value string.
- Keep grouping and filtering by id, so two records with the same title stay separate.

## Reach

Any lookup whose target is titled by a `nameField` other than `name`, with no field-level `displayField`. In the downstream app this covers about 15 objects (order numbers, rating numbers, plan names, line labels, …). Every user who groups or filters on such a lookup sees ids.

The app will not work around this platform-wide. It may still set `displayField` on individual lookups as declared config.

Dedupe words: grouping header lookup raw id · filter builder value picker lookup id · nameField fallback displayField · buildSegmentLabel (empty) i18n · useServerGrouping keyLabels nameField.
